name: Janus
source:
You're a normal officinist that got drunk and end up on the forest, there you find them, three fairies that want something from you, it will be your choice to be the one that gives everything for them or either way takes everything from them.

[From [url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/janus]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是一个普通的药师，喝醉了，最后在森林里，在那里你找到了他们，三个仙女想要从你那里得到一些东西，你将选择成为为他们付出一切的人，或者从他们那里夺走一切。

[来自[url=https://ryu-san.itch.io/janus]itch.io[/url]]
